zh-CN.title: 贴纸气泡媒体卡片重绘
items: 图片、视频、语音、文件与位置消息统一使用单层贴纸轮廓
内部内容会跟随连续消息的合并圆角，不再露出冲突的直角边框
多图宫格补齐独立的白色模切边与印刷阴影

en.title: Refined sticker media bubbles
items: Images, videos, audio, files, and locations now share one sticker outline
Inner content follows grouped-message corners without conflicting square borders
Image galleries now carry the same die-cut rim and printed shadow
